errors.text_span: with tick marks at intervals of roughly 0.02
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are not at regular intervals. The gaps between consecutive values vary, for example, the gap between 0.73 and 0.79 is 0.06, while the gap between 0.82 and 0.83 is 0.01.
The line style for "Initial Accuracy" is a dash-dot line, not a dashed line.
The description states that the "Initial Accuracy" line rises to ~0.90 at an initial confidence of 0.79, but the plot shows this value is clearly above the 0.9 grid line, at approximately 0.92.

The description incorrectly reports a dip for the "Δ Accuracy" line at an initial confidence of 0.87. At 0.87, the value is approximately 0.16. A significant dip to ~0.04 occurs at an initial confidence of 0.90.
